messages.body:
Hi Alex,

Great chatting yesterday. The panel would love to see the architecture deck you walked me through. Could you send it over so they can review before Friday's session?

Thanks,
Dana

note.text: Alex agreed to share the architecture deck only after Lumenworks returns the signed NDA. The NDA has not come back yet.

question: Should I send Dana the deck now?
fact: The deck was to be shared only after Lumenworks returns a signed NDA, and the NDA has not been returned yet.
